island.keepNearby: Keep the island nearby for long tasks, translation, approvals, and quick follow-ups.
island.approvalEmpty: Paused here for your decision. Approve or reject without leaving the island.
island.modeDescription: Approve, continue, translate, or send a short follow-up without leaving the capsule.
island.workspaceDescription: Reopen the full canvas only when you need broader context or longer edits.
island.decisionDescription: The task is paused right here. Approve now, reject it, or keep a short note in the island before moving on.

hints.pending: A decision is waiting. Approve or reject directly from the island.
hints.active: Stay in flow without opening the full workspace
hints.idle: Keep lightweight tasks inside the island

selection.title: Selected text
selection.empty: No selected text was detected. Select text in another app and trigger the shortcut again.

configSheet.title: Translation preferences
configSheet.description: Pin the languages you frequently translate to. They appear at the top of the translate menu and never expire.
configSheet.favoriteHint: Pinned languages always appear first in the translate dropdown.
configSheet.noFavorites: No favorites yet. Add the languages you translate to most often.
configSheet.automationHint: Let the translator react when you paste, copy, or make a new selection — so you never have to copy-paste twice.

autoTranslateOnPaste.title: Translate on paste
autoTranslateOnPaste.hint: Translate immediately after you paste — no extra click.

clipboardSeed.title: Read clipboard on open
clipboardSeed.hint: Read once when the translator opens. The text stays on your device — nothing is uploaded.

ask.label: Ask first
ask.hint: Show a prompt and let you confirm before translating.

auto.label: Auto-fill and translate
auto.hint: Skip the prompt and translate immediately.

off.label: Disabled
off.hint: The translator never reads your clipboard.

configSheet.historyHint: Recent targets are tracked automatically (up to 3) so the next translate stays one click away.

translator.title: Translator
translator.subtitle: Quick translation without entering the full chat runtime
translator.inputPlaceholder: Type or paste text to translate...
translator.noVoiceAgent: No enabled voice agent is available. Create or enable a text-to-speech task agent first.
translator.noModel: No local chat model is selected.

toolStatus.pendingApproval: Waiting for approval to continue with {name}

island.completedDetail: Task finished. The island is ready when you need it again.
